segments.text: One of Lia's personal ninjas, she does all the dirty or secret jobs that Lia orders her to do. While seemingly apathetic from the outside, Kanami is actually very concerned with her ability as a ninja. It's implied that she is always training by herself to hone her skills. She longs to be a normal girl, but that's an impossible dream. Lia ordered her to keep tabs on Rance, a job that she hates since she also hates him.
She later fell in love with Rance and gave birth to his daughter, Kentou Uzume.
リーザス王女リアの直属忍者。
小柄で素早く、忍者としての力をおおいに発揮するが、
出身のJAPANの忍者の里では中忍程度。
女の色香を使う『くのいち』の技は未修得。
リア専属の忍者。
忍者としての能力はそれほど低くはないのだが、天才的な鈴女とは残念ながら比べ物にならない。
現在は、リアの命令でランスの警護という名の監視を行っているが、
過去、ちょっかいを出された事も多く、ランスの事はあまり好きではない。
リーザス王国女王の直属の忍者。
ランスがリーザス国内でのある事件を調べていた時、女王（当時は王女）リアの命令による妨害工作を仕掛けてランスと出会った。
以来、ランスにベタ惚れになってしまったリアの命令でランスの監視任務についていることが多く、だいたいはランスがいる部屋の天井裏にいる。
小柄で素早く、忍者の能力はそこそこあるのだが、本人は普通の女の子として幸せになりたいと願っている。
以前はリーザス王女直属で、今はランス専属の女忍者。
才能はあるのだが、いまいち修行が中途半端になってしまった永遠の発展途上忍。
「見当」は本当は苗字ではなく忍者として授かった別名。
リーザス王女リアに仕える忍者。
主人と任務に忠実で、冷静に行動しようと努める普通の女の子。
「最っ低……初めて会った時から思ってたけど　やっぱ最低ね……」

现任利萨斯女王莉雅的直属女忍者，mask出身于位于JAPAN关东地区的风魔忍军。在年幼的时候到大陆去游学，但在途中与朋友走散，在利萨斯被莉雅捡到后服侍于她，因此被风魔忍军视为逃忍（抜け忍）。（初期设定是在战场上为莉亚所救。）只听从莉雅的命令，负责谍报与暗杀作业。在小光诱拐事件后与兰斯成了孽缘，负责当他与女王之间的联络人。刚开始时极为讨厌与兰斯做爱，但因为莉雅的命令就是要服侍兰斯，所以无法脱离这个不幸。加奈美是兰斯十位命运中的女人（運命の女）之一。原本是一位不管任务多么困难都会泰然处之的女忍者，不过随着年纪增长开始对“普通女孩子的生活”产生憧憬。忍术方面并不大出色，但因为时常与兰斯做爱，才能限界也因此提升。如果只看才能界限，还是有十万人选一的卓越才能。伊贺忍军首领犬饲认为如果她多加努力的话可以达到中忍水准。与利萨斯红色军团副将美娜德‧西塞是好朋友。在《战国》中回到故乡JAPAN，发觉自己的忍术才能跟故乡的忍者相较之下显得微不足道。曾接受伊贺忍者首领犬饲的锻炼。在《Quest》中，接受了变成幽灵的铃女加强忍术各项才能的基础训练。/mask
喜欢穿带有青蛙 logo 的内衣。
The maid, secretary and childhood friend of Lia. Wise and tricky, she is also very devoted to Lia.
リア付きの筆頭侍女。
リアを盲目的に溺愛しており、彼女が望むことなら非人道的な行為でも進んで行うという、怖い一面を持つ。
極めて有能な人材で、リーザスを裏から実質的に支配しているのは、マリスだという噂。
リアのことを除けば、才色兼備の頼れるお姉さんである。
利萨斯首席侍女，负责王女莉亚的大小事务。
溺爱莉亚到了病态的程度。
莉亚掌权后辅助政务，职责类似于宰相。

segments.text: Lia Parapara Leazas is the recently crowned Queen of Leazas.

Her hobby used to be torturing girls, but ever since Rance punished her for it, she has been restrained from further kidnappings. She is obsessed with Rance, her love for him is so intense that she would give him the entire country if he asked. She refers to Rance as "Darling".

Leazas has prospered under her rule, even though she was recently coronated. However, many nobles hate her and her ways and have tried to take her down in the past or even go as far as assisting enemy countries.
From AliceSoft Wiki
大陸東北部に位置する大国・リーザス王国の現国王。
利益のためには容赦なく他者を切り捨てることができる、まさに王に足る素質を持つ女王……と称されているが、実際は侍女のマリスが実権を握っているともっぱらの噂。
ランスに処女を奪われてから、ランスのことを「ダーリン」と呼んで追い続けている。
陰謀渦巻く王宮で育ったためか、マリスなどの側近を除いて基本的に人を信用していない。
Ｓ属性が強く、趣味は女の子いじめ。
特にランスに近しい女性には容赦がない。
（ランスにお仕置きをされてからは控えている）。
抱いているのはライトニングドラゴンの「はるまき」
世界一豊かなリーザス王国の王女様。
父王はまだ健在だが、実質的に国の運営を取り仕切っている。
才色兼備で、優しい笑顔で国民からの評判も上々。
非の打ち所がないように見えるが……？
自幼便与其侍女玛丽斯一同参与丑陋的政治斗争，并胜出
最终让父王退位，自己坐上了女王之位
其后，她在政治、经济、外交方面大展拳脚
让利萨斯王国成为了最强王国，是一位年轻优秀的女王
养有一只幼体雷龙当宠物

Hikari Mi Blanc is a noble from the Kingdom of Leazas. A pretty girl with short red hair and a gentle demeanor, who has mysteriously disappeared. It's her case that Rance has to solve in the first game.

She used to be a student attending Paris School, but was kidnapped and tortured by the then princess of Leazas, Lia Parapara Leazas. Her disappearance was the reason Rance was called to investigate the disappearance of several girls. She ended up being rescued by him.
Edited from AliceSoft Wiki
名門の女子校・パリス学園の優秀な生徒で、さらに貴族のお嬢様。
ランスが探すよう頼まれたターゲット。
もちろんランスは性的なターゲットにもするつもり。
本名ヒカリ・ミ・ブラン。リーザス城下に住む金持ち、ブラン家の次女。ふわっとした赤い髪をショートにした青い瞳の美少女としてランス1を起動するといの一番に登場する。現在はAL教のシスターを務めており、クルックーやセルといった他のAL教神官や後にAL教関係者となるサチコ程ではないが、才能限界も並の人間以上のものがある。
かつてはパリス学園に通う学生だったのだが、学園長に特別生徒に任命されてしまった為に、誘拐されて約一ヶ月の間王女の玩具としていじめられてしまう。しかし、ランスの活躍によって救出され、以降は彼を「王子様」として慕っていく事になるのだが…。

Founder and leader of the Keith Guild, for which Rance works. Keith is the one who sent Rance on his mission to find Hikari. Keith isn't liked by Rance but the reward for the girl is something that the protagonist cannot refuse.
ランス達が暮らすアイスの街で「キースギルド」という冒険者ギルドを営むギルドマスター。
悪人面だが、意外と面倒見がいい。
仕事中に関わる女には見境無く、女が関わらない仕事は嫌がるランスにいつも手を焼かされている。
キースギルドの長。ランスとの仲は余り良くないがその実力は認めており、ランスに合うような冒険の仕事をくれる。6や戦国においても名前だけは登場する。maskクエストではコパ帝国に移住し、再びランスに仕事を与えるギルド長として顔つきで復帰、秘書のハイニと結婚し子供を授かった。/mask

Menad Shisei is among the youngest of Leazas Knights, being a talented girl that worked hard to gain a respectable position. At 15 years old, she was already strong enough to be given the role of the Gatekeeper of the Leazas Castle in the Capital of Leazas.
At 17 years old, became the 2nd in command of the Leazas Red Corps, the strongest unit of the Leazas Army.

Menad is rather tomboyish and unwomanly most of the time. She's usually very serious and is a very diligent girl that takes her responsibilities very seriously, always trying her best in every situation. Her attitude has made her be treated like a boy rather than a woman for most of her life, and led her to develop a sense of insecurity with herself and complex for her lack of feminine qualities. While on duty she's extremely serious, but she is a surprisingly honest and cheerful girl in her daily life, perfectly showcased in her times with one of her best friends Kanami. Unfortunately, she's also clearly young and naive, and can sometimes be fooled or manipulated rather easily by people who want to take advantage of her position.

Menad also has a love for the sword, and admires strong and talented fighters, growing to immensely respect her General and mentor Rick Addison. She admires him greatly due to his outstanding swordsmanship, being the reason why she started wielding a sword instead of a spear when joining his army. He trained her in the art of the sword and she's even copied his special move the By-La Way, creating her own special attack called "Kua-Lu Lane", which is similar to Rick's trademark attack, albeit less powerful.
From AliceSoft Wiki
リーザスの街中を警備する、都市防衛隊に所属する女兵士。
普段は人から見れば退屈な門番役だが、役目だからとせいいっぱい頑張る。
街で不穏な事件があると、非番の日にそれを追いかけたりしている。
門番から副将に出世、がんばっている
かなみの友達でよく昼飯を一緒にしている

Millie Lincle is a shopkeeper working in the capital of Kingdom of Leazas in a Weapon Shop called Akirame (also called Lost Hope in English). This weapon shop originally belonged to her father, but she inherited it and kept managing after his decease.

She's frequently assaulted by thugs and the like, but she somehow always manages to be saved in one way or another. Despite her lack of combat skills, physical training, or even motivation to fight back, she's always saved by different circumstances. This is product of her "absolute luck". For some reason, Millie possesses an ability to be absurdly lucky at all times, to the point she can get whatever she wants and nothing bad will happen to her as long as she doesn't wish for it. This, however, backfired and led her to realize there were no challenges in life and she started to feel like living had no meaning, which has made her quite jaded about life itself and at times made her flirt with wanting to die.
From AliceSoft Wiki

The innkeeper in charge of an Inn in the capital of Leazas called Icecream.

She wasn't actually born in Leazas and is in fact from the eastern country of JAPAN, making her habits and looks different to that commonly seen in Leazas. She wears a beautiful long red kimono and her inn has a JAPANese ambience. She serves JAPANese tea and the beds are also JAPANese, which gives customers a more unusual inn.
From AliceSoft Wiki

ディーラーとしては凄腕で、ここ一番の勝負では負けたためしがない。

Patty is a shopkeeper working in the capital of Leazas in an Item Shop called Baltic. It is designed as a beachside clubhouse, and as such she both sells general items and shaved ice. She can't make up her mind as to what to focus on. She's great at cooking Yakisoba, a JAPANese dish that originated as a variant of fried noodles.

She's a cheerful and optimistic girl. She thinks of Rance as an interesting person. She loves water and hot environments, and dreams with going to a beach sometime and see a real sea. After she became the owner of her store, she decorated it with shells and spread sand on the floor to simulate a small beach in it. She also dresses accordingly.

segments.text: Pulptenks Flanders is an active and cheerful girl that works as a waitress in her father's pub in a capital of Leazas. She's beloved by all her customers and happily serves with a smile every day.
From AliceSoft Wiki
リーザスの酒場『ふらんだーす』の看板娘。
学生として学校に通う傍ら、父親がいない時は料理や店番もする。
盗賊団にさらわれて、現在行方不明。
ランス1では
かぎりない明日戦闘団に囚われていた酒場のマスターの娘。ぱとらっしゅの親父が男手一つで苦心して育て上げた評判の美人。長い薄緑の髪で、少し健康的に焼けた肌が魅力的。父親とは仲がいい。
助けに来たランスに、半裸で鎖に繋がれたまま2回も弄ばれる。足の速さに自信があるそうで、魔物を怖れずに盗賊の洞窟から一人で帰っていった。盗賊達には色々とされてしまったようだが、本人は引きずっていないようだ。
ランスにも襲われたのに、いつもニコニコと元気で好意的。お酌に手料理にと甲斐甲斐しく世話を焼いてくる。むしろ結婚話に乗り気。
ランス01では
性格が若干変わり、それに合わせて一人称も「あたし」から「私」へと変更された。

リメイク版の01では処女を奪ったのはランス（本人は気付いていない）だが、盗賊団のリーダーに処女を奪われる直前までねちっこく調教された結果淫乱の素質が開花してしまい、ランスのセクハラも口では嫌がるものの体ではその気になっていたり、心の声を読むと（性的な意味で）ランスに襲ってほしいと思っており、さすがのランスもまずい（結婚させられる）と思ったのか手を出せなくなる。ランスが思わず揉みしだきたくなる程の巨乳。
盗賊団から救出後、すぐに酒場へ行かず宿屋へ行くとランスと添い寝する事になる。本当に添い寝だけで抱き枕にされる。
普段は学生のため、日中に酒場へ行っても父親がいるだけ。夜間のみ父親と交代で酒場の店番をしている。ランスが行くと一生懸命料理を作ってくれる。（ランスが食べきれない程）
名前を読み間違えると恐ろしいことになるらしい。どう恐ろしいかは謎。 (そのわりに名前が長いのでスタッフから「パルテン」と略して呼ばれている)
アリスソフト公式による人気投票ではなんと1位に。ただの町娘が優勝という波乱の結果になってしまった。
ランス03では

妄想力に拍車をかけて再登場。リーザス城下町からヘルマン軍を一掃したランスが、リアを伴い酒場に訪れたことで再会した。そこでヘルマンの占領下、自分がどれだけ慰み者にされ嬲られたかを涙ながらに熱弁するのだが……酒場は荒されてないわ無類の酒好きヘルマン人が何一つ酒瓶に手をつけてないわで、ランスの憐憫を買うための一種の虚言だと思われる。既にランスとの婚姻届を用意しているなど、極まった腹の据わり具合に怖れをなしたランスは手をつけることを断念した。尚、その様子を見ていたリアはランスが女の子にモテることを再確認、以後ライバルを増やさないよう情報規制を敷いていくのであった。

A fearsome warrior known throughout the land, not just for his impressive battle skills but also for his shameless womanizing ways. While he's driven more by his primal instincts than noble ideals, his actions often result in unexpected heroism.

Even though he's rough around the edges, Rance often ends up doing good deeds on his many adventures, even if he doesn't intend to. His exploits are varied, including battling fearsome demons, standing against rival nations, and even helping out those in distress.

Unironically, Rance's disorderly conduct frequently lands him in hot water. His relentless chase of carnal indulgences tends to create more facepalm moments than applaudable ones, adding to his already infamous reputation.

On his frequent adventures, Rance is not a lone wolf. He is often accompanied by a cast of unique characters who add their own spice to the narrative. However, these companions, notably his enslaved romantic interest Sill Plain among others, often find themselves grappling with his audacious behavior. Despite the hurdles, this diverse crew manages to unite their skills, forming a solid team crucial to their shared escapades.

Sill is a slave purchased by the great adventurer Rance in the year LP0001 prior to the events of Rance 01. Rance purchased her for 15,000 GOLD and has been forced to travel alongside him wherever he goes since then. However, Sill developed strong romantic feelings for him and, even though the "Absolute Obedience Magic" once cast on her has long since worn off, she remains single-mindedly loyal to Rance regardless. She was originally from a rich family in Zeth but under "certain circumstances" ended up in the slave market sold to Rance.

She is capable of using both offensive and healing magic, in addition to the creation of magic barriers. She is also known to have a large knowledge of worldly culture and history, as well as an understanding of many creatures. This is apparently due to her studying from a wide variety of books at a young age due to her origins from a noble family.
From AliceSoft Wiki

segments.text: Bobza is the owner of a popular tavern in the capital of Leazas were many adventurers and fighters of the coliseum gather. He has many different quality wines and types of alcohol to serve, and offers a warm and casual service.
His daughter, Pulptenks Flanders, works as the waitress in the pub. He loves her very much and is very protective.

When she was kidnapped during the events of Rance 01, he was crushed by the event and couldn't work on his tavern properly. Luckily, Rance rescued her, which made Bobza be overjoyed and incredibly thankful towards his benefactor.
From AliceSoft Wiki
リーザスの酒場『ふらんだーす』の亭主で、パルプテンクスの父親。
父一人子一人の家族のため、娘を溺愛している。
本来は豪放磊落な性格だが、娘が誘拐されてからは意気消沈して、商売にも身が入っていない。
酒場の名前がビストロ酒場「ふらんだーす」に変更となった。普段から客が来なくて困っているらしい。コルドバ・バーンの行きつけの酒場であり、本人の名前でボトルキープされた酒瓶が置いてある
昼は父親のボブザ・フランダースが、夜は娘のパルプテンクス・フランダースが店番をしている。娘によると、夜に店に居ないのはラーメンの修行に行ったらしい。
パルプテンクス救出後はすっかりランスを気に入ってしまい、コルドバの酒を振る舞ったり娘を結婚させようとしている（娘自身もランスに抱かれたいと思うまでに好きになっている）。このため日中の酒場にてランスが武器を抜いて「やいおやじ、金を出せ！」と親父を襲うと「分かった、この店とパルプテンクスをやろう」と言われ、流石のランスも諦めざるを得なかった。

多くの歴史的大乱、戦乱においてもその戦禍の中心……からちょっと外れたあたりで活躍してきた

Necai Sys was the second in command of the gang of thieves that were living near the Leazas Castle under the lead of Reichardt.
When Reichardt was killed, Necai abandoned the life of a thief and became an adventurer by taking jobs of the Keith Guild.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Julia Lindum is a member of the Leazas Royal Guard, formed from the strongest women within the military and dedicated to protecting the Royal Family. Unfortunately, Julia didn't attain the rank of Royal Guard due to her strength but instead because of her family's connections.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Yulang Mirage is the champion gladiator of the Leazas Castle Coliseum.

Yulang is well-known throughout the nation as an undefeated warrior and a remarkable beauty, which make her very popular as a gladiator. Her reputation is so great that she has been hired by the royal family several times to accomplish difficult mercenary work.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Lavender was a student of a prestigious Paris academy of Leazas. However, she ended up being abducted by the then Princess of Leazas, Lia Parapara Leazas.

The princess used her to satisfy her sadism and continuously tortured her heavily and using healing magic to prevent her from dying of the wounds. Everyday she would be used as the princess' toy in the periods of time between 9:00 to 11:00. She eventually couldn't take it anymore and commited suicide. However, a strong attachment to life led her Soul to remain and turn her into a Ghost, since it wasn't really her wish to commit suicide.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Jericho is a pretty childish girl that works as a prison guard, albeit she's not very good at her job since she tends to fall asleep instantly if she gets too bored.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Willis Fujisaki is the personal Level God of the great adventurer and Lord of the Rance Castle, Rance, and has been acting as his personal assistant to raise his Levels over the course of his many adventurers.
From AliceSoft Wiki

The official mascot of Alice Soft. A polite young girl who often communicates with the player as a medium in some Alice Soft games. She sometimes represent marketing upcoming Alice Soft games in trailers and advertisements.
She is accompanied by her pet black crow named Yukichi.
Aki Del is the younger sister of Yuki Del. She asks Rance to save her sister.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Klean Bew is a dutifully and cheerful maid that currently works on Rance Castle, although she used to be a maid in Leazas Castle. She is in mostly in charge of duties related to cleaning and tiding, and loves doing so.
Very shy and meek, she loves doing her job, and tries to make everything clean, neat, and tidy.
In the MangaGamer release her name has been changed to Fey Breeze, a pun of Febreze, an odor elimanator made by Procter & Gamble.
From AliceSoft Wiki

segments.text: Jean Gangvang II is the son of Duke Gangvang, an influential noble from the Kingdom of Leazas.
A haughty and arrogant nobleman, Jean spend much of his time abusing his father's wealth and status to force others to cater to his every whim.

Jean become fascinated by Yulang Mirage, the champion gladiator of the Leazas Coliseum, a woman renowned for both her great strength and exceptional beauty. Jean approached Yulang multiple times and attempted to convince her to retire from her career as a gladiator to become both his personal bodyguard and his wife, but was routinely rejected by the female warrior, who was only interested in strong men.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Heidi is a dutiful maid that works on Leazas Castle.

Despite not having a Maid skill, she does her job proficiently and decently enough to work, and she's dedicated enough for it. However, she has a weird personality pathology. She becomes a complete kleptomaniac with bread. If she sees bread she has the urge to steal it no matter what, which has led her to be kicked out from previous jobs in the past.
In the Mangagamer translation, her last name was changed to Bredeter, which may either be a pun on "bread eater" or a portmanteau of "bread" and "predator".
From AliceSoft Wiki

Mi Lordring is a fanatical priest of the AL Church. Through sheer grit and enthusiasm, he rose from the position of an ordinary priest to one of the four bishops that serve directly under the pope, placing him among the highest authorities in the Church.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Yuki Del is the older sister of Aki Del and is imprisoned in the Leazas Castle dungeons.
She is guarded by Jericho Colon and later rescued by Rance.

segments.text: Louis Quitowack is an adventurer of the Keith Guild.

A mild-mannered man in spite of his appearance, Louis works hard as an adventurer to pay off the staggeringly high debts that he has amassed across his life. Despite this, however, he has a tendency to take on jobs that are too difficult for him to complete due to them offering the largest reward. This results in him frequently failing them, causing him to rarely ever obtain the money he requires and making him one of the lowest-ranking members of his guild.
From AliceSoft Wiki
British, frequently referred to as Concrete Man, is the former leader of the Legendary Five, the strongest adventuring party in history.

British was born to an ordinary Human family during the chaotic reign of the malicious Demon King Gele. Throughout his youth, he experienced the terror and despair brought about by Gele's cruelty firsthand. Unable to have his spirit broken by his torturous living conditions, British made a vow that he would someday liberate humankind from its Monster oppressors by defeating Gele.

In his early twenties, British began traveling the world in order to both become stronger and to find a way of piercing the Invincibility Field that made the Dark Lords and their master impervious to conventional damage. Throughout his journey, his earnest charisma and inspiring character drew many influential and powerful people towards him, including the thief Chaos, the samurai Nikkou, the priestess Café Artful and the mage Ho Raga. United under British's leadership and a shared desire to defeat the Demon King, the five became a close knit group of skilled adventurers who quickly became famous across The Continent for their heroic deeds.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Alexander is a tall man with a muscular physique, dark red hair and large, prominent eyebrows. In his youth he wore a red sleeveless karate gi, while in his later years he wears red plate mail in addition to gaining a scar across his right eye. Throughout his appearances, he wears a distinct red cape.
